step_by_step_reasoning:
The architecture diagram displays an automated security monitoring and remediation pipeline on AWS, integrated with an on-premises ServiceNow instance.

1. Scanning / Security Sources (top row):
   - AWS Config (AWSConfig), GuardDuty (GuardDuty), Access Analyzer (AccessAnalyzer), and Fargate running Prowler (Fargate) all send security findings into AWS Security Hub (SecurityHub).
2. User Persona - Platform Engineer:
   - Platform Engineer (UserCompanyDeveloper) interacts with Security Hub to review findings.
3. Remediation Pipeline:
   - Security Hub sends findings/events to EventBridge (EventBridge).
   - EventBridge triggers Lambda functions (Lambda) for automated remediation.
4. User Persona - Sec Ops Engineer & ServiceNow Integration:
   - Sec Ops Engineer (UserCompanyAgent) uses ServiceNow (ServiceNow).
   - There is a bidirectional line/arrow between Security Hub and ServiceNow for synchronization of security findings and incident creation.
